messages:
Maya Chen: quick sync — a healthcare prospect asked for 13 month trace + logs retention with per-tenant export. want to discuss feasibility + priority for Q3
Oliver Park: 13 months is outside our current retention SLAs. cost and infra changes required. do we have a customer commitment or POC? :thinking:
Maya Chen: they mentioned HIPAA readiness and legal review — it's a sales-led deal, likely >$250k ARR if we can commit to retention + private deploy options
Cheng Li: two angles: storage cost (ingest + retention) and query perf on long traces. we can tier older data to cold storage but need export path + RBAC for tenant-level exports
Sara Gomez: product question — is this an ask for Console UI (ability to query 13mo) or just backend export & legal proof? we should separate UI vs infra scope
Maya Chen: both. they want: 1) 13mo retention guarantee 2) tenant export endpoints 3) ability in Console to filter traces older than 90d -> 13mo
Oliver Park: propose we treat as enterprise-only feature behind Dedicated/Private. minimal hosted exposure to avoid cost blowout
Cheng Li: technical tradeoffs:
- short-term: implement cold-tier + read-through fetch (adds latency for old queries)
- medium: index compaction for long-tail traces (costly engineering)
- long-term: add per-tenant retention rules in object store + lifecycle policies
Maya Chen: timeline ask: sales wants an answer by EOW. can we scope an MVP by end of next quarter? (Q3)
Sara Gomez: for Console UX we can mock a disabled "13mo" toggle and show pricing/enterprise CTA. that buys time while infra work ships
Oliver Park: launch criteria proposal for MVP:
- infra: cold-tier storage + lifecycle enforcement configured per-tenant
- infra: tenant-export API with audit logs
- perf: 95th pctile query latency for 30-90d unchanged, 90-365d allowed +200ms degradation
- security: KMS + audit trail for exports
- docs: runbook + customer-facing SLO note
Cheng Li: add regression tests: simulate 1TB/day ingest, check compaction and query correctness for 6mo+ traces
Maya Chen: + include acceptance criteria from legal for HIPAA controls (DLP, access logs). legal will need sample config
Oliver Park: resource ask: eng estimate 3 sprints infra (2 engs), 1 sprint API (1 eng), 2 sprints Console (1 frontend, 1 designer) => 6-7 sprints parallelized => likely 2 months if we staff
Sara Gomez: UX mockups needed. I'll drop a quick prototype by tomorrow. @Avery Design to help on enterprise CTA copy
Avery Patel: copying in here. will produce two mocks: one for Console filter UX, one for export workflow (email + signed S3 URL flow)
Maya Chen: customers asking for pricing guidance — do we set a premium retention surcharge or include in Dedicated contract? pricing input from finance please
Finance Bot: FYI — preliminary pricing models: +25% on Dedicated reserved capacity or $X/TB/month for cold-tier storage. need usage profile to finalize
Cheng Li: quick technical note: queries spanning hot+cold will need federated query. simplest path: proxy query to hot index and to object-store fetcher, then stitch results ordered by timestamp. code sketch:
```
GET /traces?start=2024-02-01&end=2024-12-31&tenant=acme
// proxy: hot-db query (90d)
// cold-fetch: object-store range scan + pre-filter by trace id
// merge-sort results, then dedupe
```
Oliver Park: that sketch is fine for MVP but watch out for tail-latency. suggest async job UI if query hits cold path and takes >5s
Maya Chen: sales want clear yes/no and a rough delivery plan. can we give a conditional yes: enterprise-only, phased rollout, pricing surcharge, EOW commitment
Sara Gomez: agree. deliverable for EOW:
- one-pager: scope + launch criteria + proposed price + risks
- timeline Gantt with owners
- UX mocks (invision links)
Cheng Li: I'll own infra estimate + tech risks doc
Oliver Park: I'll own SLAs + performance acceptance
Maya Chen: I'll pull legal checklist + confirm customer POC commitment
Avery Patel: I'll post the two mocks by EOD tomorrow
Finance Bot: assigned: finance to finalize surcharge after usage sample. need at least 30 days of telemetry or simulated numbers
Maya Chen: action items recap:
- Cheng: infra estimate & tech risk (by Thu)
- Oliver: SLA & perf acceptance doc (by Thu)
- Sara/Avery: UX mocks + copy (by EOD tomorrow)
- Maya: legal checklist & customer confirmation (by Thu)
- Finance: pricing tie-breaker (wait for usage sample)
Sara Gomez: ok — if everyone hits their dates we can respond to sales with conditional yes and an estimated Q3 delivery window
Maya Chen: thanks team. ping me in DMs if blockers. closing thread.
